DAILYBOT_CREATE_CHECKIN.title: Create check-in
DAILYBOT_CREATE_CHECKIN.description: Create a Dailybot check-in from a template with POST /v1/checkins/. This is not POST /v1/checkins/create/.

members_uuids.description: User UUIDs to add as members.

teams_uuids.description: Team UUIDs whose members will be added.

frequency_type.description: Schedule type, for example daily or weekly.

frequency.description: Frequency, for example every_day, two, or four.

DAILYBOT_FIND_WORKFLOW.title: Find workflows
DAILYBOT_FIND_WORKFLOW.description: List Dailybot workflows with GET /v1/workflows/. The call is body-less and does not set Content-Type.

featured.description: Filter by the caller's private Featured state.

prioritize_featured.description: When true, Featured rows sort first.

DAILYBOT_SEND_MESSAGE.title: Send message
DAILYBOT_SEND_MESSAGE.description: Send a Dailybot bot message with POST /v1/send-message/. Provide message or messages, and at least one target.

message.description: Message text. Required unless messages is set.

messages.description: Platform-specific payloads. Required if message is omitted.

target_users.description: User UUIDs, emails, or external ids.

thread.description: Parent timestamp or id for a thread reply.

target_channels.description: Channel ids, or objects with id and optional channel_type and thread.

target_teams.description: Team UUIDs. Every member receives the message.

skip_users_on_time_off.description: Skip users flagged as out of office.

bot_message_id.description: Idempotency id. Re-POST within 72 hours to edit.

thread_responses.description: Up to 10 replies under the same parent.

items.description: Button object. Nested callback, modal, and response fields follow the Dailybot button contract.

buttons.description: Up to 25 link or interactive buttons.
